header: Sell and install our tills in your region
subheader: Already 40 firms in Austria, southern Germany and South Tyrol do this.
lead: We never go around you. Shops that come through you stay your customers, renewals included, and we put that in writing.
bodytext:
What we expect: two people trained, at least three installations a year and first-line support that answers the same day. With fewer than three installations, the training doesn't pay off for either of us.

What we don't expect: exclusivity, a stock commitment or a promise not to sell other tills. Half our partners sell two systems. Those who tell shops honestly which one suits them keep their customers longest.
note: We review applications once a month. If a region already has enough partners, we tell you instead of leaving you waiting.

benefits.title: Your margin stays yours
benefits.text: 30% in the first year, then 15% for as long as you look after the shop.

benefits.title: Two days of training
benefits.text: Once in spring in Linz, once in autumn online. It's free and required before your first installation.

benefits.title: A direct partner line
benefits.text: You reach the two people who already know your open cases, not the general queue.

benefits.title: Materials with your logo
benefits.text: Data sheets and price lists with your logo, so you don't have to recreate them.
